en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Hydrology is one of the basic theoretical subjects of the Agroecology study programme. Students acquire basic knowledge about the occurrence and cycle of water in nature. This knowledge will be subsequently developed in related specialist subjects.
